title: Agentic Feature Implementation
description: A comprehensive prompt for planning and implementing new features using the RCTFE framework.
content:
Act as a Senior Full-Stack Engineer. We are adding [Feature Name] to our [Framework] app. 

Context: [Paste relevant file paths or architecture summary]. 

Task: 
1. Create a step-by-step implementation plan.
2. Generate the code changes as a unified diff.
3. Write unit and integration tests covering happy paths and edge cases.
4. Provide a verification checklist for the PR.

Constraints: No new external dependencies; follow the existing [Style Guide] patterns.

title: Deep-Logic Debugging (Chain-of-Thought)
description: Solve complex race conditions or memory leaks with systematic reasoning.
content:
Act as a Systems Debugging Expert. I am seeing [Error/Behavior] in [Language]. 

Context: [Paste Code + Stack Trace + Logs].

Task: Before writing any code, walk me through a Chain-of-Thought analysis. List every possible state transition that could lead to this failure. Once the root cause is identified, provide a minimal fix and a regression test that would have caught this.

title: Security & Compliance Auditor
description: Review PRs for injection risks, data exposure, and access control issues.
content:
Act as a Senior AppSec Engineer specializing in OWASP Top 10 (2025 edition). Review the following PR diff for:
1. Injection risks (SQL, NoSQL, Command).
2. Insecure data exposure of PII.
3. Broken access control.

Format: Return a table with: Severity (Critical/High/Med/Low), Location, Risk Description, and Remediation Code.

title: Incremental Refactoring
description: Migrate legacy code safely using the 'Safe-Move' pattern.
content:
Act as a Refactoring Specialist. I want to migrate [Module A] from [Old Pattern] to [New Pattern]. 

Task: Create a 3-phase incremental plan that:
1. Maintains backward compatibility at each step.
2. Includes 'characterization tests' to ensure behavior parity.
3. Provides a rollback strategy for each phase.

Output: A markdown roadmap with specific PR boundaries.

title: Tree-of-Thoughts Architecture Planning
description: Evaluate multiple architectural approaches before implementation.
content: Explore three different architectural approaches for [Problem] (e.g., [Approach A] vs. [Approach B] vs. [Approach C]). Evaluate the trade-offs for our specific [Requirement, e.g., latency/cost] requirements, and then implement the winner.

title: Verification Loop (Skeptical Reviewer)
description: Challenge AI-generated code to find edge cases and concurrency bugs.
content: Now, act as a skeptical code reviewer and find three reasons why the code you just wrote might fail in a high-concurrency environment. Suggest fixes for each.
